Ye 'early' signal hai (palatne se pehle pakadne ki koshish), isliye risk kam rakha aur aadha profit T1 par book hota hai. Iska pichla backtest record negative tha, to ise experiment samjho.

reasons: Momentum dheema pad raha hai (pichle 3 ghante -0.0 ATR)
Volume kam ho raha hai (normal ka 0.5 guna)
Pichli candle mein upar (trend ki taraf) se rejection wick hai: bhaav wahan tik nahi paya
mgmt.hold_vs_book: Hold: target 3.6R door, stop tak 0.4R (R/R 9.4). Abhi book karo to +-0.6R pakka.

raw.lesson: Jaldi haar (2 ghante, best +0.2R): entry ka timing theek nahi tha ya achanak volatility ne stop tod diya.

auto.verdict: 🟡 Normal haar: sirf tay risk (-1.2R) gaya. Is tarah ki strategy mein aksar 3 mein 2 trade harte hain.
